title: AI capex digestion debate — what we are watching
content: Three signals we are watching for the AI infrastructure capex debate: (1) hyperscaler 2026-Q2 earnings commentary on 2027 capex guidance, (2) upstream silicon order-book extensions vs cancellations, (3) datacenter power-purchase agreement renewal pricing. Our base case continues to support a 12-18 month capex tailwind; we would change the call if any two signals turn decisively negative. Implications: stay overweight Contoso AI & Infrastructure Thematic for growth-mandate clients; trim discretionary on a >15% drawdown; do not chase late entries above current ATH.
